name: Alliant Energy
description:
We use our energy every day to bring our Purpose to life: To serve our customers and build stronger communities.

Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) provides regulated energy service to approximately 1 million electric and 430,000 natural gas retail customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.

Our mission statement: We deliver the energy solutions and exceptional service our customers and communities count on – safely, cost-effectively, efficiently and responsibly.

name: Architectural Design Consultants, Inc.
description: ADCI is a Wisconsin-based architecture and design practice with offices in Madison, Lake Delton, and Appleton. We pair broad planning, technical design, BIM, interiors, and construction-administration capability with direct access to senior decision-makers. That structure matters on a municipal facility: questions are resolved quickly, commitments remain visible, and the people introduced in the proposal stay accountable through construction.

name: ATC
description: We are a Wisconsin-based, federally and state-regulated utility with more than a 25-year history in building, operating and maintaining the regional power grid. Our system spans portions of Wisconsin, Minnesota, Illinois and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, delivering reliable energy to more than 5 million consumers. More than 700 employees work to keep the power flowing, so you have the energy you need when you need it. The safe and reliable operation of our system, combined with the dedication of our people, creates the vital connection between where power is generated and where it is needed.

name: Baird
description: Baird is dedicated to meeting the long-term goals of our public, private and nonprofit municipal issuers through nationally ranked advisory, underwriting, placement agent and consulting services.

name: Baxter & Woodman, Inc.
description: Founded in 1946, Baxter & Woodman, Inc. provides consulting engineering and technology services to municipalities, state agencies, county governments, and sanitary districts throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Florida, and Texas. Clients receive planning, design, construction, and operation/maintenance services for a variety of projects including transportation, wastewater, water, stormwater, GIS, operations, IT consulting and SCADA technology, and general municipal public works.

name: BEAMING
description: We are thrilled to welcome Siesta, a miniature therapy horse from BEAMING Inc.! BEAMING is dedicated to enhancing quality of life through equine-assisted therapies, clinical services, and trauma-informed programs that build healing connections between horses and humans. Be sure to stop by and meet Siesta to learn more about how BEAMING empowers individuals facing physical, emotional, and behavioral challenges to grow, connect, and thrive.

name: Biodiesel (MEG Corp)
description: Municipal fleets are increasingly looking to green their fleets and operate more sustainably. Biodiesel is a clean, renewable, high performance alternative to diesel fuel that can be used in your existing diesel fleet without modifications. Visit the Biodiesel booth to find out how easy it is to reduce your fleet’s carbon footprint with biodiesel, while using a fuel that supports Wisconsin’s farmers and local economies. Biodiesel is good for the environment, good for your fleet and good for Wisconsin.

name: BKV Group - Architects & Engineers
description:
BKV Group is a holistic design firm providing a full complement of
architecture, interior design, engineering, landscape architecture, and
construction administration services. Our core belief is that regardless
of project type, design has a profound impact on the community, and
our responsibility as a multidisciplinary firm is to enhance the economic,
aesthetic, social, and environmental context of the communities we shape
and design. Established in 1978, BKV Group now has 220+ employees sharing knowledge across our offices throughout the country, and creating meaningful design solutions that allow our clients’ dreams to become a reality.

name: Bolton & Menk, Inc.
description: Bolton & Menk, Inc. specializes in providing community infrastructure solutions. Since 1949, we have been committed to improving quality of life through engineering excellence and client satisfaction. From advocating for our communities to designing their dreams to finding funding, we take pride in our work because we live in these same communities. Today, Bolton & Menk has more than 1,000 employees throughout 40 locations in Minnesota, Iowa, North Dakota, Wisconsin, Colorado, North Carolina, and South Carolina, providing services to more than 400 communities and agencies.

name: Bray Associates Architects, Inc.
description:
Bray Architects is a trusted and innovative leader in educational and civic design. 

We guide our clients through their full journey, from planning and community engagement to architecture and interior design. Our team draws on a depth of knowledge to create lasting, meaningful, and creative solutions that shape lives and communities for the better.

name: CBS Squared Inc.
description: CBS² is a single-source, multi-discipline engineering, architecture, surveying, and grant writing firm. With four offices across Wisconsin, we are a woman-owned DBE/TGB firm specializing in civil, structural, transportation, water, and environmental engineering and land surveying. We provide comprehensive water and municipal services, including drinking water engineering solutions, water and wastewater treatment, distribution and collection systems, stormwater management, municipal infrastructure design, and related surveying and construction oversight. We support communities with grant writing and funding assistance, bringing critical projects to life. We deliver innovative, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions that improve quality of life while protecting natural resources.

name: CEDA
description: CEDA has provided fractional community and economic development staff capacity for rural communities, counties and economic development organizations for forty years.

name: Cedar Corporation
description: Cedar Corporation is a Community Infrastructure, Architectural, and Environmental Services firm with five office locations across Wisconsin. Founded in 1975, Cedar has grown to more than 100 employees committed to professionalism, high-quality service, and clear communication. We serve municipal governments, industries, public utilities, and public and private entities, assembling experienced teams to meet the demands of each project. Our success is rooted in understanding and achieving our clients’ goals while providing exceptional service and building lasting relationships within the communities we serve.

name: CESA Purchasing
description: CESA Purchasing provides procurement support to entities across the state of Wisconsin including public, private and charter schools, municipalities, libraries, museums, etc. We hold 150+ contracts with our vendor partners that can be utilized by purchasers to receive pre-negotiated discounted pricing. Our contracts, services and support are all completely FREE to the purchaser.

name: Community Infrastructure Partners
description: Community Infrastructure Partners (CIP) was built to challenge the status quo of infrastructure delivery. We replace traditional approaches with performance-based programs designed around the needs of communities. No bloated overhead. No time-and-materials billing. No one-size-fits-all design and engineering templates. Instead, we bring strategy, implementation, and accountability together to move infrastructure from planning to progress. From cleaner water to more resilient infrastructure, CIP helps communities make every dollar work harder while keeping public health, transparency, and measurable outcomes at the center. The result: infrastructure programs structured to cut unnecessary costs, accelerate implementation, and deliver lasting value to the communities they serve.

name: Construction Business Group
description: To assist state agencies, counties, cities, village, towns and other public entities, CBG has collected publicly available information and documents on over 14,000 businesses. Information and documents have been gathered from state and federal agencies, Wisconsin state courts, federal courts, municipal clerks and a variety of other public sources.

name: CP2 Consulting
description: CP2 Consulting is a strategic planning firm that exclusively serves local government and nonprofits. We help organizations turn vision into action through strategic planning that is practical, community-informed, and built to last. Just as importantly, we strengthen the governing bodies that steer those plans. Our board development work aligns elected officials and trustees around shared priorities, clarifies roles, and builds the trust and skills that effective governance requires. Grounded in real-world public sector experience and endorsed credentials, CP2 helps leaders set direction, engage residents, and deliver results that matter to the communities they serve.

name: Davy Engineering Co.
description: Davy Engineering Co. has been providing engineering consulting services for communities as well as commercial and residential development for 95 years. Our major areas of consulting involve municipal water systems (supply, storage, distribution and treatment), wastewater collection and treatment, streets and stormwater management.
